title: Reporting Meniscal Tears
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: State the extent and whether the tear reaches a surface.
State whether a fragment is displaced and where it has gone.
Report the root separately, because a root tear behaves unlike a body tear.
Extrusion with intact tissue raises a different question from a tear and should not be merged with one.
- The report should state what could not be assessed.
